source.author: verg
source.text: Hunc procul ut campo Turnus prospexit aperto, ante levi iaculo longum per inane secutus sistit equos biiugis et curru desilit atque semianimi lapsoque supervenit et pede collo impresso dextrae mucronem extorquet et alto fulgentem tinguit iugulo atque haec insuper addit:
source.text_original: Hunc procul ut campo Turnus prospexit aperto, / ante levi iaculo longum per inane secutus / sistit equos biiugis et curru desilit atque / semianimi lapsoque supervenit et pede collo / impresso dextrae mucronem extorquet et alto / fulgentem tinguit iugulo atque haec insuper addit: /
source.text_english: When Turnus caught sight of him far off on the open plain, he checked his team and leapt from the chariot, having followed him a long stretch through the empty space with a light spear, and came upon him as he fell half-dead and collapsed, and with his foot pressed on his neck he wrenched the sword from his right hand and plunged it, gleaming, into his deep throat, and besides this added the following:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_original: ' / dixit et ingenti flammantem nubila sulco / direxit per inane facem, quae puppe propinqua / in bifidum discessit iter fratresque petivit / Tyndareos, placida et mediis in frontibus haesit / protinus amborum lumenque innoxia fundit / purpureum, miseris olim implorabile nautis.
reuse.text_english: He spoke, and with a mighty furrow he sent through the void a blazing torch that, as it drew near the ship, parted into a twofold course and sought the sons of Tyndareus; peaceful, it at once clung to the middle of both their brows and pours forth a harmless purple light, once a thing to be implored by wretched sailors.
